name: Marinated Cucumber, Red Onion & Queso Fresco Salad (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Dressed in lime vinaigrette with raw red onions, cucumber seeds/skins, and unaged queso fresco.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip this salad to avoid lime juice and raw red onions; choose Mamá Imelda's Chicken Tortilla Soup (strained) instead.
watchOuts: Raw red onion fructans and cucumber skins
